title: Link discovery
description: What a gateway returns on its link for a GET of /.well-known/qory-configuration: where the session posts its events and where it opens a run. Unsigned: the link's transport authenticates it. It lists no node, no server key and no secrets endpoint, which are the gateway's toward the server. A member Forager does not recognise is ignored.

version.description: The document format. Forager refuses a version it does not read.

events.description: Where the session posts its batches and which events. On the local link the URL is http://localhost and a path; behind a separate gateway it has the origin of session.gateway.url.

run.description: Where the session opens a run, with a POST of its run request. On the local link the URL is http://localhost and a path; behind a separate gateway it has the origin of session.gateway.url.
